card.name: First names before a surname
card.fires_on: A person's first name, a first initial or part of a first name, in bylines, credits and quotes, right where a surname comes next.

modes.label: First name in a credit or quote
modes.description: A first name after a title or 'by' that introduces a named person, with the surname still to come.
modes.example: Messenger photos by<< John>> Matuszak Toshe

modes.label: Partway through a first name
modes.description: The end of a split first name or an initial, just before the last name.
modes.example: Ter<<rie>> Koss, infection preventionist at Dayton

modes.label: Initial before surname
modes.description: The period after a middle initial, followed by a surname.
modes.example: Philip Zoeller and J. F<<.>> Stendebach, and stands directly

card.writes: It pushes toward capitalized name-like words, but the output effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on a person's first name when the last name is about to follow, as in bylines and credits.
